english.title: Use vehicle on a road fitted with blue warning beacon / special warning lamp / device resembling
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), fitted with a

(A)_[blue warning beacon]_
(B)_[special warning lamp]_
(C)_[device resembling a blue warning beacon]_
(D)_[device resembling a special warning lamp]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 16 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
use a vehicle
on a road fitted
with a blue warning beacon OR
special warning lamp OR
device resembling a blue warning beacon OR
device resembling a special warning lamp

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 16 does not apply to emergency vehicles.
(ii) Regulation 16 applies whether the device is capable of working or not.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings H2601 and H2602.
(v) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
